description: "Kenelm Chillingly — Complete" by Edward Bulwer Lytton is a novel written during the mid-19th century. The story revolves around the life and philosophical musings of its titular character, Kenelm Chillingly, and explores themes of identity, existence, and the expectations placed upon individuals by society and family.
